title: Refract review findings (candidates)
description: ai/runs/<run_id>/reviews/<agent>-<lens>.json — what one read-only review lens returns: CANDIDATE findings, not verdicts. The reviewer ends its final message with this JSON; the SubagentStop hook persist-review.sh extracts it, validates it against this schema and the posting bar (templates/snippets/posting-bar.md), stamps `signer`, `authors`, `scope` and `round` from the hook input and the repository, and writes the file. A reviewer holds no Write tool and never claims those stamped fields. Candidates at IMPORTANT go to the verifier in refute mode (templates/snippets/refute-before-report.md); only its verdict decides what blocks.

lens.description: The axis reviewed: correctness, performance, a11y, data, observability, security-<lens>, maintainability, conventions, ux, architecture, test …

severity.description: The posting-bar vocabulary. PRE-EXISTING = in code this change neither introduced, touched nor copied; it never blocks.

kind.description: <lens>/<class>, e.g. correctness/off-by-one, performance/n-plus-one, a11y/missing-label. An enumerated class, never free text.

claim.description: The restated claim: When <condition reachable in real use>, <code at file:line> produces <observable wrong outcome> instead of <expected outcome>.

evidence.description: What the reviewer read or ran that raised the candidate.

detector.description: Optional: the detector section that raised it, <pack>/<skill>§<n> (e.g. database/n-plus-one-scan§2). review-dismissals.py computes each detector's dismissal rate from it (spec § 5.8).

round.description: Stamped: 1 for the lens's first review of this run, then +1. From round 2 the posting bar admits IMPORTANT only.

escalate.description: Stamped true when round >= 3 still carries an IMPORTANT finding — an upstream problem for a human, not a fourth round.

ref.description: The command run, or both ends of the trace as file:line → file:line.

result.description: What it showed: the failing assertion, the measured delta, the violation id.

signer.description: Stamped by the SubagentStop hook from its own input — the model never writes it.

authors.description: Stamped: every agent type that edited a scoped path, from the edit ledger test-lock.sh keeps (.claude/evidence/edits.jsonl); `main` for the main session or an edit the ledger did not see.

scope.description: Stamped: the change the record judged — every path touched since the merge-base (run records, evidence and locks excluded) plus the run's acceptance.json, each with its blob hash. gate-check.py recomputes it; any difference makes the record STALE, and a stale record is a FAIL.
